name: Human Resources
source:
A visual novel horror game about what it means to be human. There are no right answers, only well-reasoned ones.

[From [url=https://nebbyenbalade.itch.io/human-resources]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部關於「怎樣才算是人」的恐怖視覺小說。這裡沒有標準答案，只有能用充分理由支撐的答案。

［取自[url=https://nebbyenbalade.itch.io/human-resources]itch.io[/url]］
